sections.heading: Core Concepts: Applications of similar triangles

questions.q: In $\triangle ABC$ studying applications of similar triangles, $m\angle A = 39^\circ$ and $m\angle B = 45^\circ$. What is $m\angle C$?
questions.answer: Using the triangle angle-sum theorem, $m\angle C = 180^\circ - (39^\circ + 45^\circ) = 96^\circ$.

questions.q: A geometric figure scaled by factor $k = 2$ has an original side length of $8\text{ cm}$. What is the corresponding image length?
questions.answer: Multiplying the original length by the scale factor gives $8 \times 2 = 16\text{ cm}$.
